I only need two sprays to get enough so I like that even thought these are small they will last and I have some variety! If you have any questions, please feel free to ask me. If you found my review helpful, let me know and click YES.

The price itself is what got me as this collection cost only slightly more than what one of the bottles and this size would have cost me. reviews.t: Just got it and i have to say i like all of the scents
reviews.x: Just got it and i have to say i like all of the scents. Originally wanted the Oxford Blue, but decided to go with the variety pack to try them all out. Did a blind smell test with my family members! Me, my gf, and my mom really like Arrogant and Orford Blue, my brother loves Oxford Blue and Notting Hill. The Riviera, my gf says, smells like an old man scent, but a really good old man scent. Over all very very happy with my purchase. I'm going to wear all of them multiple times to decide which on
Oxford Blue is by far the best. The 3 of the 4 scents that were there smelled great - my husband loved them, but the 4th, Notting Hill, was completely empty (as if it had never been filled).

I thought Rivera was the one for me.  I had a sample of that and was about to buy the bottle.  I bought this and was so happy I did.  Notting Hill is pretty damn good and is my favorite.  They are all in bottles/sizes that allow you to have a wider variety of scents without having to worry about a small sample size or buying the whole bottle. Arrived quickly and packaged safely & attractively. My husband was really happy with this, as he can try out the different fragrances before buying a full size. The size of the samples provided are quite large (for samples, anyway), which was another bonus!

Excellent cologne's . i got this set for the Arrogant cologne because I got a sample in a subscription box and I loved it. But I found that in the larger bottle in this set, the orange smell that I like isn't as prominent, but it's still fine. Besides that  the shipping was quick. The black box the set came in, was very nice, sturdy, and I'm keeping it for bow tie storage.

reviews.t: Unusable extreme synthetic contains paint remover
reviews.x: A blind buy. Friend mentioned liking something from English Laundry so I bought this set to sample. Apparently these scents are their least popular. Synthetic off the chart . Wore one day and regretted ever spraying it. Customer service refunded no return required. Also contains denatured alcohol, which is paint remover.

Bought this collection for y son and he LOVES the selections. Of course he has his favorite - Oxford Blue - but there isn't one of the four that he doesn't like. Great collection for someone who likes a choice of "unique" colognes.

My first exposure to English Laundry cologne was a BirchBox sample of Arrogant. The very first time I tried it I loved it and received several compliments. I ordered the full-size version from Amazon and it has been my favorite ever since. You really will almost always get complimented or asked what you’re wearing. reviews.t: Love love love English Laundry colognes
reviews.x: Stumbled upon English Laundry about 3 years ago.  Have tried a few different scents and love each one. I have tried some high end colognes that turn on (scent changes) me but each one of these have garnered more compliments. I love these smaller bottles because I travel every week for work and they are great for ease of packing and I can use a different one every week.

My wife loves these scents.  I can mix fragrances or stay with one at a time without complaint.  The scent lasts all day without being over-bearing.  I also like that I can switch up on different days because I have 4 at my disposal.  English Laundry is a an excellent choice!

The package arrived with a missing cologne. A little disappointed in myself for not just buying this in the store. It would have been $18 extra in store , but at least there would have been all 4 colognes included.
Whether as a gift or for yourself this set won't disappoint. The four scents are different enough that you will more than likely have one if not two favorites.
This variety of scents definitely covers anytime of day and occasion. Although package presentation suffered a bit. Do better AMAZON with product handling.

I am not sure as to whether my husband likes or dislike these sample sized colognes, but; what he did say is he couldn't smell them after an hour or so.

reviews.t: Already owned the Oxford blue and loved it, but couldn't travel with it due to ...
reviews.x: Already owned the Oxford blue and loved it, but couldn't travel with it due to it being the large bottle. Love the price since on the oxford site they actually sell just 1 bottle this size for $32. 2 reason I didn't give a 5 are Reason1. only 2 are actual Eau de Parfum and 2 are Eau de Toilette. reason2 the sticker to allow me to know the difference was missing from 3 of the 4 bottles. Hopefully they come out with a travel set with the other fragrances i like. Cambridge Knight, and Signature.

reviews.t: received it pretty fast with the prime membership option from Amazon
reviews.x: I bought this item a few days ago, received it pretty fast with the prime membership option from Amazon. Unfortunatly one of the bottles (the blue one) arrived defective. I just contacted an Amazon representative on the issue who gave me an outstanding service. He decided to refund me the item right away while i am still able to use the other three bottles that are in good working order. Great product and amazing customer service from Amazon !!!!!!!!!!!!!!

I got this as a Christmas gift for my husband.  It arrived very quickly and very well packaged.  I love all the scents and I wasn't sure i would. I love that they are all nice sized bottles. i really like the mock snake/alligator print box the colognes come in, it will look really nice on our dresser.

I'm always looking for something that smells unlike what everyone else is wearing. English Laundry fits the bill 100%. I now own one of everything that they make. Sometimes when I'm in a mood I'll even mix two or three different ones together and come up with something totally awesome.
The variety of scents is great. I typically rotate which one I use each week, and my last set lasted about a year using it daily. Arrogant is my favorite and I get lots of compliments on it.

reviews.t: This is a great value! The scents are unique
reviews.x: This is a great value! The scents are unique, high quality, and all smell great. My husband loves the variety.
Using oxford blue and the Riviera now. I get lots of compliments. I'll surely purchase larger sizes soon

reviews.t: Variety is the spice of life!
reviews.x: All four have their merits but, I prefer the lighter tones of Nottinghill the best.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the variety of scents in the set, often noting they like all or most of the four fragrances and enjoy having options for different days or occasions.
Many reviewers say the set is a great value and a good way to try multiple fragrances before committing to a full-size bottle, with the sample sizes being generously large.
Several reviewers report receiving compliments on these colognes and describe them as long-lasting without being overbearing.
A few reviewers report problems with the packaging or contents, including a missing or empty bottle and damaged presentation.
One reviewer strongly disliked the scents, describing them as extremely synthetic and unusable.
